  Interface: sdk

  Setup hints: MINDEE_API_KEY

output_text:
```python
import os
from typing import Dict, Any, List
from mindee import MindeeClient
from mindee.product import InvoiceV4


def extract_normalized_expenses(document_path: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    api_key = os.environ["MINDEE_API_KEY"]
    mindee_client = MindeeClient(api_key=api_key)
    result = mindee_client.load_document(document_path).parse(InvoiceV4)
    prediction = result.document.inference.prediction

    line_items: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    if prediction.line_items:
        for line_item in prediction.line_items:
            line_items.append({
                "description": line_item.description.value if line_item.description.value else None,
                "quantity": line_item.quantity.value if line_item.quantity.value is not None else None,
                "unit_price": line_item.unit_price.value if line_item.unit_price.value is not None else None,
                "total_amount": line_item.total_amount.value if line_item.total_amount.value is not None else None,
                "tax_amount": line_item.tax_amount.value if line_item.tax_amount.value is not None else None
            })

    normalized = {
        "supplier_name": prediction.supplier_name.value if prediction.supplier_name.value else None,
        "customer_name": prediction.customer_name.value if prediction.customer_name.value else None,
        "invoice_number": prediction.invoice_number.value if prediction.invoice_number.value else None,
        "date": prediction.date.value if prediction.date.value else None,
        "due_date": prediction.due_date.value if prediction.due_date.value else None,
        "subtotal": prediction.total_net.value if prediction.total_net.value is not None else None,
        "tax_amount": prediction.total_tax.value if prediction.total_tax.value is not None else None,
        "total_amount": prediction.total_incl.value if prediction.total_incl.value is not None else None,
        "line_items": line_items
    }
    return normalized
```
